src='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the full separator row or column.
    sep_r = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    sep_c = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if sep_r is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep_r], grid[sep_r + 1:]
        # Compare rows equidistant from separator.
        n = min(len(a), len(b))
        a, b = a[-n:], b[:n]
        width = w
        ca = Counter(x for row in a for x in row)
        cb = Counter(x for row in b for x in row)
        common = set(ca) & set(cb)
        color = max(common, key=lambda x: min(ca[x], cb[x]))
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color for c in range(width)] for r in range(n)]
    sep = sep_c
    a, b = [row[:sep] for row in grid], [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    n = min(sep, w - sep - 1)
    ca = Counter(x for row in a for x in row)
    cb = Counter(x for row in b for x in row)
    common = set(ca) & set(cb)
    color = max(common, key=lambda x: min(ca[x], cb[x]))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]

    sep_r = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)

    if sep_r is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep_r], grid[sep_r + 1:]
        # Compare rows equidistant from separator.
        n = min(len(a), len(b))
        a, b = a[-n:], b[:n]
        width = w
        ca = Counter(x for row in a for x in row)
        cb = Counter(x for row in b for x in row)
        common = set(ca) & set(cb)
        color = max(common, key=lambda x: min(ca[x], cb[x]))
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color for c in range(width)] for r in range(n)]
    sep = sep_c
    a, b = [row[:sep] for row in grid], [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    n = min(sep, w - sep - 1)
    ca = Counter(x for row in a for x in row)
    cb = Counter(x for row in b for x in row)
    common = set(ca) & set(cb)
